title: Reading a long email from a pen friend

objective.en: Read a long email from a US pen pal and follow how the writer feels about each event and what they hope will happen next.
objective.fr: Lire un long e-mail d’un correspondant américain et suivre ce que l’auteur ressent pour chaque événement et ce qu’il espère ensuite.
objective.de: Eine lange E-Mail eines US-Brieffreunds lesen und verstehen, was der Schreiber zu jedem Ereignis empfindet und was er sich für die Zukunft erhofft.

meta: Subject: Lots of news from Denver!
paragraphs: Hi Sam, thanks for your last email! Sorry it took me so long to reply. Things have been really busy here.

First, the big news: I got the job at the bookshop downtown! I'm so excited, because I start next Monday. My manager seems really friendly, but I'm a bit worried about working on weekends. I'm hoping to still have time for soccer with my friends.

Second, my sister Emma is moving to New York in August to study music. I'm really proud of her, but I'll miss her a lot. I can't wait to visit her in the fall, although my mom says the flights are expensive.
Last weekend my team lost the final by one goal. I was so disappointed, but the coach said we played well. Next season, fingers crossed, we'll win the cup!
Anyway, enough about me. How is your new school? Are you still nervous about the exams? Write back soon and tell me everything! Your friend, Jake
Hi Sam, great to hear from you! I'm writing from my grandparents' farm, where we are spending two weeks.
I'm thrilled because I'm learning to ride a horse. It's harder than it looks, and I fell off twice yesterday! I'm a little nervous about tomorrow's lesson, but my cousin says I'll be fine.
I'm also hoping to visit you in December. Dad is going to check ticket prices next week, and I'd love to see snow in your town! Write back soon. Mia
